race.comment: MAKE IT SNOW (4) made a very sound debut at this track, finishing third over 1200m after travelling well and closing off strongly to be beaten just under two lengths by Heza Hellraiser. The way he finished off suggests the rise in trip is a big tick and now Pike rides. Can shed the maiden. SUNBLOOD (8) resumed with a fourth at Northam, beaten just under three lengths, and her effort through the line suggested she has come back in good order. Well placed from the barrier draw and with natural progression, she'll be hard to hold out. BONDEX (1) flew late behind a smart one last start and that form lines up again on Wednesday at Belmont - so we'll get a guide to that. Drawn better now and can put his best foot forward. FLASH FORTUNE (5) has been unplaced in both starts, but is third-up, draws well and can improve if the return from 1600m sharpens him. RULESOFADMIRATION (10) can improve under this scenario.
